description: Connect a Pincushion project to Slack, Microsoft Teams, or Discord using an incoming webhook. Low-noise defaults mirror Figma-style subscriptions: pin activity plus the deploy/verify loop, where pin_deployed/pin_verified attach as a quiet threaded reply under the pin (never a new top-level message). The louder agent-pin, email-pin, and share-report events are opt-in. For Discord, create a channel Incoming Webhook (Channel Settings → Integrations → Webhooks) and pass its URL.

events.description: Events to send. Default: pin_ready, new_pin, mention, follow_up, resolved, pin_verified, pin_deployed.

name.description: Subscription name. Use multiple names for separate project/page subscriptions. Default: default.

pageUrlPatterns.description: Optional URL substrings for page-specific subscriptions. Empty means all project URLs.

sendTest.description: When true, posts a one-time test message to the webhook after saving.

status.description: Pause without deleting the subscription. Default: active.

targetLabel.description: Human label for the destination, such as #design-review or Teams QA channel.

webhookUrl.description: Slack incoming webhook URL, Microsoft Teams incoming webhook/workflow URL, or Discord channel webhook URL (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...). Stored server-side and not returned in full.
